params.metadataUri: Optional URI to the manifest or model card ("" allowed).

verifyModel(string,bytes32).details: public (not external) so verifyManifest can call it internally —      external functions with calldata params cannot be called internally.

returns.verified: True iff the model is registered AND its on-chain         manifest hash equals `candidateHash`. Unknown repos => false.

allRepoIds().notice: All registered repo ids (small registries only — O(n) copy).

getModel(string).notice: Full record for a repo id. Reverts if not registered.

hashManifest(string).notice: Pure helper mirroring the CLI's manifest hashing, so the same         bytes hash identically in EVM and Python.

registerModel(string,bytes32,string).notice: Register a model's artifact manifest fingerprint.

transferOwnership(string,address).notice: Transfer record ownership (e.g. when a model changes maintainer).

updateManifest(string,bytes32,string).notice: Update the manifest hash / metadata URI of a model you own.

verifyManifest(string,string).notice: Verify a full canonical manifest string against the chain.         This is the "trustless" check: hash the manifest yourself,         compare on-chain — no off-chain oracle involved.

verifyModel(string,bytes32).notice: Verify a candidate manifest hash for a repo id.
